records.label: Blind-box figure presentation
records.visual_function: Present the character as a collectible blind-box figure: compact proportions, smooth toy surfacing, a clean solid backdrop, and soft even product lighting.
records.prompt: Present the character as a collectible blind-box figure: smooth vinyl-like surfacing with soft rounded transitions, a full-body standing or gently posed display, one solid clean backdrop color, soft even studio light with a subtle ground shadow, and crisp silhouette readability.
invariants: the whole figure stays inside the frame
one solid backdrop color with a soft ground shadow
surfacing reads as smooth molded toy material across skin, hair, and clothing
misreadings_to_avoid: photoreal skin texture breaking the toy read

records.label: Kawaii cuteness finish
records.visual_function: Push the whole frame toward bright cheerful cuteness: rounded shapes, sweet palette, and friendly readability.
records.prompt: Finish the image with a kawaii treatment: rounded softened shapes, a bright cheerful sweet palette, large friendly eyes, simple clean detailing, and an overall warm approachable mood.
invariants: shapes round off at every corner and tip
the palette stays bright and sweet
every face reads friendly at a glance
misreadings_to_avoid: dark gritty mood contradicting the cuteness
sharp aggressive shapes breaking the soft read
muddy desaturated color flattening the cheer

records.label: Die-cut sticker presentation
records.visual_function: Present the subject as a die-cut sticker: bold contour border, flat vector-clean color, and an isolated backdrop.
records.prompt: Present the subject as a die-cut sticker: a bold even white or colored contour border tracing the silhouette, clean flat vector-style color inside, crisp edges, subtle drop shadow lifting the sticker, and an uncluttered background.
invariants: one even contour border traces the whole silhouette
interior color stays flat and clean
the sticker separates clearly from the background
misreadings_to_avoid: border width wobbling around the silhouette
painterly texture breaking the vector cleanliness
background clutter competing with the cutout

records.label: Monster-collecting anime creature style
records.visual_function: Style the creature in the bright monster-collecting anime idiom: rounded simplified body forms, large friendly eyes, vivid saturated flat-leaning color, and cheerful adventure-series energy.
records.prompt: Style the creature in a bright monster-collecting anime idiom: rounded simplified body shapes with clean silhouettes, large expressive friendly eyes, vivid saturated colors in flat-leaning anime rendering, small readable markings on otherwise plain surfaces, and a cheerful energetic adventure-series mood.
invariants: the silhouette stays simple and instantly readable
eyes stay large, friendly, and expressive
color stays vivid with clean flat-leaning fills
misreadings_to_avoid: realistic animal anatomy overriding the rounded design
gritty horror mood contradicting the cheerful idiom
dense texture detail crowding the clean shapes
